name: SMS / RCS
summary: An agent can text any phone through a messaging provider such as Twilio, which delivers inbound messages to a webhook and sends replies through an API. RCS adds branded senders and rich media on Android and iOS 18 devices. In the US, application-to-person SMS from long-code numbers requires A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration.
facts: Official carrier channels via providers (e.g. Twilio Programmable Messaging)
$0.0083 per segment in or out, plus carrier fees (Twilio)
$0.0083 per segment (Rich), $0.022 per message (Rich Media), plus carrier fees
A2P 10DLC registration required for US long-code SMS
goodFor: Reaching users without any app install
Notifications and short back-and-forth with an agent
watchOut: US registration (A2P 10DLC) before sending at scale
Per-segment and carrier fees add up for long replies
Plain SMS has no rich formatting or streaming
